message.zh: 26.4.11 是重要更新：新增游戏原生风格的性能初始化引导与分档配置，全面改用当前游戏版本的官方数据和九种语言资源，并集中优化库存、规划、购物清单、行动队列、资产中心与 DPS。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Version 26.4.11 is an important update. It adds a native-style performance setup with configurable profiles, moves fully to official data and all nine locale resources for the current game version, and delivers focused improvements to Inventory, Planning, the shopping list, action queues, Asset Center, and DPS. Update on Greasy Fork.
